lead.headline: MISSILES FALL IN POLAND
lead.sublabel: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland as Moscow's huge barrage hit Ukraine. PM Tusk calls it a deliberate provocation on NATO soil.

panels.headline: TRUMP TELLS EUROPE: STOP FUNDING KYIV
panels.sublabel: In an angry call after the Shenzhen summit, Trump urges Europe to withhold Ukraine funds. Berlin's coalition holds firm, pledging €70 billion for 2027.

panels.headline: UKRAINE HITS CRIMEA BRIDGE AGAIN
panels.sublabel: Kyiv strikes the Kerch Bridge for the third time in four days. Zelensky calls it a fair response as Russian attacks on the capital continue.

panels.headline: AI SELL-OFF SINKS WALL STREET
panels.sublabel: US stocks fall 3.7% as an AI and chip rout pushes the S&P 500 and the Dow into correction territory.

panels.headline: COP31 TALKS GO INTO OVERTIME
panels.sublabel: The UN climate summit in Antalya misses its deadline, with nearly 200 nations deadlocked over fossil fuels.

panels.headline: CANCER PILL GIVES NEW HOPE
panels.sublabel: A trial pill, daraxonrasib, made pancreatic tumours undetectable in one in 12 patients — a rare breakthrough against a deadly cancer.
